issue.title: Problem with next argument matching flag name with no default command.
issue.body:
https://github.com/urfave/cli/blob/fd14621cbcd644aa35483480d40f7cdf7b69f4c0/command_run.go#L276

In the case where a command has no DefaultCommand and has a flag with the name of the next argument, the line above inserts a spurious empty string ahead of the flag name. This causes existing code expecting the flag name in element zero to fail because an empty string is there instead and the expected flag name is in element one.
